memory_update.text: MOD should remain in the liquid-cooling node watchlist because Airedale by Modine has direct CDU product evidence for data-center liquid-cooled and hybrid architectures.
FLEX is a hidden liquid-cooling integration candidate through JetCool, with exposure spanning cold plates, CDUs, manifolds, quick disconnects, manufacturing, and lifecycle support.
WTS is a second-order component candidate for valves, strainers, and flow-control hardware in liquid-cooling loops; materiality still requires verification.

The liquid-cooling bottleneck should be mapped at component level, not just system level: CDUs, cold plates, manifolds, quick disconnects, valves, strainers, coolant chemistry, leak detection, serviceability, and qualification cycles are all possible chokepoints.
Layer 2 should verify customer qualification and revenue materiality; product-page evidence alone is insufficient to prove AI-rack economic sensitivity.

node: Liquid cooling and thermal-management components for high-density AI racks
summary: Expanded the liquid-cooling component universe with one reference anchor and three less-obvious US-listed or US-traded public-market mappings. The strongest direct component/integration evidence in this pass is Eaton/Boyd Thermal, Modine/Airedale CDUs, Flex/JetCool cold plates and CDUs, and Watts valves/flow-control products used in data-center liquid-cooling loops. The underfollowed angle is not generic HVAC exposure, but qualified leak-resistant closed-loop components, CDUs, cold plates, manifolds, quick-disconnect-adjacent flow hardware, and service/manufacturing know-how required for high-density AI racks.
